methodology: Median warm time per entry after symmetric 1.5×IQR outlier filtering; raw samples and exclusions are retained. Each runtime warms for at least 150 ms, calibrates a batch, then measures the recorded number of batches. Every timed return-value checksum is verified. Printed output is verified before timing; timed output uses a null sink (native) or byte callback (web). Formatting and runtime-specific I/O remain included. Includes the host call boundary and budget reset where required; excludes loading, process startup, downloads and offline compilation. Tiny examples emphasize call overhead. Shared machines and uncontrolled clocks; no universal target ranking.
